user.title: Phicomm R1
user.description: IP of the speaker and its WebSocket port. Press Submit to check.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the speaker (no connection or unexpected reply).

init.title: R1 speaker settings
init.description: Speaker address and Home Assistant address. The microphone listen key and port are issued automatically per speaker, nothing to type: the APK setup command (with the key) is shown to administrators on the speaker's Connection card. To tune audio (voice gate, noise, duplex) tick «Edit advanced parameters».

data.ha_url: Home Assistant address the speaker calls (empty = guess)
data.rotate_intercom_key: Rotate the intercom URL key (old go2rtc lines stop working)
data.nang_cao: Edit advanced parameters (voice gate, noise, duplex)
data.ghep_lai_apk: Re-pair the speaker APK (new key; the APK fetches it by itself)
data.adb_server: adb-server address (optional; leave EMPTY to connect straight to the speaker IP, port 5555)
data.adb_mode: How to reach the speaker over ADB: auto, server (via adb-server) or direct (straight to the speaker)

nang_cao.title: Advanced audio parameters
nang_cao.description: Every value here is a default NOT yet measured on the R1; leave as is without a reason.

data.talk_tail_s: Wait after playback before reopening the mic (s)
data.noise_strength_db: Noise suppression: max reduction per band (dB)
data.noise_voice_db: Noise suppression: voice threshold (dB above floor)
data.agc_silence_db: AGC: below this level counts as silence, no boost (dBFS)
data.limiter_ceiling: Limiter: ceiling (fraction of full scale, 0.89 ≈ -1 dBFS)
data.duplex_vad_threshold: Duplex call: voice (VAD) threshold, probability 0-1 (0 = no filtering)
data.duplex_preroll_s: Duplex call: audio kept before speech (s)
data.duplex_hangover_s: Duplex call: audio kept after speech (s)
data.duplex_duck: Duplex call: drop quiet mic audio while HA is playing (echo cut, off by default)

error.invalid_ha_url: Address must look like http(s)://host[:port] with no path, spaces or #.
error.ha_url_loopback: 127.0.0.1 / localhost points back at the speaker or go2rtc, not at Home Assistant. Use the LAN address of the machine that runs HA.
error.ha_url_unreachable: Home Assistant could not reach this address (or it is not this Home Assistant). Nothing was saved.

get_intercom_source.name: Get intercom source
get_intercom_source.description: Returns two go2rtc.yaml source lines: talk to the speaker (talk) and listen to its microphone (listen).

ha_url.name: HA URL
ha_url.description: HA address reachable from the go2rtc host; leave empty when go2rtc shares HA's network.

get_wake_endpoint.name: Get wake endpoint
get_wake_endpoint.description: Returns the URL the wake-word service ON the speaker will POST to (speaker side NOT built yet).

ha_url.name: HA URL
ha_url.description: HA address reachable from the go2rtc host; leave empty when go2rtc shares HA's network.

set_light_function.name: Set light per function
set_light_function.description: Change on/off and the base / rim effect of a function. Each zone is {effect, params}; parameters depend on the effect (catalogue in the settings sensor attribute danh_muc).

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Any r1_speaker entity of the speaker.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off = no light while this function is active.

day.name: Base light
day.description: {effect, params} of the base light (15 RGB LEDs).

vien.name: Rim light
vien.description: {effect, params} of the rim light (24 white LEDs).

preview_light.name: Try light
preview_light.description: Run an effect on one zone for a few seconds, then return to the real state. Nothing is saved.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Any r1_speaker entity of the speaker.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Effect id in the zone catalogue, or tat.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Effect parameters; missing ones use defaults.

set_advanced_option.name: Set an advanced option
set_advanced_option.description: Change one advanced audio setting (voice gate, noise, AGC, limiter, duplex). Reloads the integration to apply (the mic reconnects in a few seconds).

stop_preview_light.name: Stop light preview
stop_preview_light.description: Stop the preview and return the lights to the real state.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Any r1_speaker entity of the speaker.

install_apps.name: Install apps on the speaker
install_apps.description: Install the apps shipped with the integration (player, device, mic APK) on the speaker over ADB, in order; a brand-new speaker uses exactly this. Returns a result per app.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Any r1_speaker entity of the speaker.

apps.name: Apps
apps.description: List of ids: player, unisound, bodam. Empty = all.

force.name: Remove old build with a different signature
force.description: If the speaker has the same package signed differently: uninstall then reinstall (that app's settings are lost).

configure.name: Configure the mic APK
configure.description: After installing the mic APK, run its setup command once (default on).
